records.public_claim_text: For example, 21 CFR 820.10(c) requires that for all classes of devices automated with software, a manufacturer must comply with the requirements in Design and Development, Clause 7.3 and its subclauses of ISO 13485.18 As part of design and development, “[d]esign and development validation shall be performed in accordance with planned and documented arrangements to ensure that the resulting product is capable of meeting the requirements for the specified application or intended use” (Subclause 7.3.7).
records.public_claim_verbatim_quote: For example, 21 CFR 820.10(c) requires that for all classes of devices automated with software, a manufacturer must comply with the requirements in Design and Development, Clause 7.3 and its subclauses of ISO 13485.18 As part of design and development, “[d]esign and development validation shall be performed in accordance with planned and documented arrangements to ensure that the resulting product is capable of meeting the requirements for the specified application or intended use” (Subclause 7.3.7).

records.public_claim_text: In addition, Subclause 7.1 of ISO 13485 specifies that the “organization shall document one or more processes for risk management in product realization.” As part of the software validation required by Subclause 7.3.7, and risk management, including the requirements of Subclause 7.1, software device manufacturers may need to establish cybersecurity risk management and validation processes, where appropriate.

records.public_claim_text: An SPDF can be integrated with existing processes for product and software development, risk management, and the quality management system at large.
records.public_claim_verbatim_quote: An SPDF can be integrated with existing processes for product and software development, risk management, and the quality management system at large.

records.public_claim_text: Because of its benefits in helping comply with the QMSR and cybersecurity, FDA encourages manufacturers to use an SPDF, but other approaches might also satisfy the QMSR.

records.public_claim_text: Transparency A lack of cybersecurity information, such as information necessary to integrate the device into the use environment, as well as information needed by users to maintain the medical device system’s cybersecurity over the device lifecycle, has the potential to affect the safety and effectiveness of a device.
records.public_claim_verbatim_quote: Transparency A lack of cybersecurity information, such as information necessary to integrate the device into the use environment, as well as information needed by users to maintain the medical device system’s cybersecurity over the device lifecycle, has the potential to affect the safety and effectiveness of a device.

records.public_claim_text: In order to address these concerns, it is important for device users to have access to information pertaining to the device’s cybersecurity controls, potential risks to the medical device system, and other relevant information.
records.public_claim_verbatim_quote: In order to address these concerns, it is important for device users to have access to information pertaining to the device’s cybersecurity controls, potential risks to the medical device system, and other relevant information.

records.public_claim_text: For cyber devices, failure to comply with any requirement under section 524B(b)(2)of the FD&C Act (relating to ensuring device cybersecurity) is considered a prohibited act under section 301(q) of the FD&C Act.
records.public_claim_verbatim_quote: For cyber devices, failure to comply with any requirement under section 524B(b)(2)of the FD&C Act (relating to ensuring device cybersecurity) is considered a prohibited act under section 301(q) of the FD&C Act.

records.public_claim_text: For cyber devices, some of the information recommended in this guidance may help manufacturers meet their obligations for what is required to be in premarket submissions under section 524B of the FD&C Act.
records.public_claim_verbatim_quote: For cyber devices, some of the information recommended in this guidance may help manufacturers meet their obligations for what is required to be in premarket submissions under section 524B of the FD&C Act.
